title: Portrait lens — 200 mm f/1.8
description: The portrait lens is a camera lens specified here at 200 mm f/1.8. Distortion: straight lines render curved — barrel or pincushion. Coma: point highlights smear into teardrop shapes at wide apertures. Corrected with a multi-element achromat. Typical use: wildlife photography.
